scene: The beetle hums in your palm, projecting three transit tokens.
picture: A flat side view along a wide tower terrace. Far left hangs the waiting red cable tram. Left, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat holds the glowing beetle. Centre sits a striped river barge below a dock gate. Far right, the green glass-roofed trolley rests on tracks.
shown: a dangling red mountain cable tram docked at an open platform, far left
a striped canal barge tied to a low pier gate, centre
